source_caption:
🎬 Girl Fight (2011)

Girl Fight follows Haley Macklin, a teenage girl who desperately wants to fit in with a popular group of girls at her high school. After finally gaining their acceptance, Haley believes she has found the friendship and belonging she has always wanted. However, everything changes when tensions arise within the group, leading to a shocking act of violence. Haley is brutally attacked by several girls she once considered friends, while another teenager records the assault and the footage spreads online. As the incident attracts widespread attention, Haley and her family struggle with the emotional consequences, public humiliation, and the difficult fight for justice. Starring Anne Heche, Jodelle Ferland, and James Tupper, the film delivers a powerful and emotional story about bullying, peer pressure, betrayal, friendship, and the devastating impact of violence among teenagers.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Crime • Teen Drama

⭐ IMDb: 6.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 1h 30m • TV-14

🎥 Director: Stephen Gyllenhaal

📚 Inspired By: A real-life incident involving a teenage girl who was assaulted by her peers and whose attack was recorded on video.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Lifetime, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming or rental availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Girl Fight is a television film that premiered on Lifetime on September 11, 2011. Inspired by true events, It stars Jodelle Ferland as Haley Macklin. The film revolves around a bullied and troubled 16-year-old girl (Ferland) who tries to fit in with a popular group of girls, leading to a brutal beating upon joining the clique. The film was inspired by a 2008 beating in Florida; a video of some of the beating, released by Polk County Sheriff Grady Judd, was used heavily by the news media and the story caused nationwide public outrage. Anne Heche and James Tupper, who play Haley's parents, were a couple in real life until their split in 2018.
